orchestration_result.final_recommendation: For the next year's procurement with a €10 million budget, allocate €3 million (30%) to supplies, €4 million (40%) to services, and €3 million (30%) to works. Supplies will be divided into three lots: Office Equipment and Furniture (€100,000, 33.33% of supplies, 10% of total budget, sustainably sourced and low emissions), IT Hardware and Software (€100,000, 33.33% of supplies, 10% of total budget, Energy Star and minimal energy consumption), and Office Supplies and Consumables (€100,000, 33.33% of supplies, 10% of total budget, recycled paper, refillable ink cartridges, biodegradable). Both the services and works specialists reported that their mandates are limited to their respective areas and do not include out-of-scope items. The award criterion for all lots is price 60%, quality 40%
